You defeated the Mechon troop leader and[XENO:n ]
reduced the Mechon's attack power.

It looks like the Weapon Creation Panel in the Central[XENO:n ]
Factory will be able to make Fiorung a new weapon.[XENO:n ]
Use the materials and make a weapon.

Use the Weapon Creation Machine in the[XENO:n ]
Control Tower of the Central Factory.
You made a weapon for Fiorung.

The lift to the Central Tower doesn't seem to work.[XENO:n ]
Find an alternative route.
Go to Maintenance Entrance 1.

It looks like you can get to the upper levels if[XENO:n ]
you use the lift in the Maintenance Wing.

The path from the Maintenance Wing to the lift is[XENO:n ]
blocked by an electrical barrier. Release the barrier[XENO:n ]
and find a way to the lift.

Use the Barrier Control Panel to release the[XENO:n ]

able to get to the upper levels through the Mechon[XENO:n ]

Find a way to infiltrate the Mechon Factory.
Collect materials for the bomb.

Use the Weapon Creation Panel in the[XENO:n ]
Maintenance Wing to make a bomb.
Use the bomb to blast open the vent.

You blasted the vent open and you can now[XENO:n ]
enter the Mechon Factory.

It seems there is a way to the Mechon Factory through[XENO:n ]
the vent. You will need a bomb to blast it open. Collect[XENO:n ]

Collect an [System:Color name=item ]Electrical Fuse[/System:Color ] from the M88[XENO:n ]
Watchtower guarding the Main Factory Gate.

Collect an [System:Color name=item ]Ether Explosive[/System:Color ] from the M97[XENO:n ]
Commander in the Large Mechon Store.

Collect a [System:Color name=item ]Timer[/System:Color ] from a flying Mechon in the[XENO:n ]
central container storeroom.

You have collected the materials to use the[XENO:n ]
Weapon Creation Panel and make a bomb.

Your way is blocked by an electrical barrier. Turn off[XENO:n ]
the electrical barrier and head to the top of the tower.
Turn off the electrical barrier.
Reach the peak of the tower.
